data.long_meaning: The name Berny is derived from the Old Germanic words bern meaning 'bear' and hari meaning 'brave, warrior'. This name is a powerful and fearless name, evoking images of strength and courage. The name Berny is perfect for a baby boy who will grow up to be a brave and strong-willed individual. The name Berny carries the meaning “Brave as a bear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Berny usually hope their child will grow to embody brave as a bear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
